_doc: Labelled query texts for find()'s query-kind reader (event = one short sound you would trim as a sample; texture = a continuous sound you would loop). 'tune' = clear-cut class phrasings from queries.json (the threshold may be set on these); 'test' = generic queries written for this check, never used to set anything.

event: a small object landing softly on a table
a rubber stretch squeak and suction pop
a satisfying plastic click as something locks into place
a short hollow pop like a cork or a finger pulled from the cheek
a single mechanical keyboard key press
a deep thocky key press on a mechanical keyboard
pressing the spacebar of a mechanical keyboard
a light tactile keyboard switch tick
a single small bell or glass ting
a plucked kalimba or celesta note
a stick swung quickly through the air
a box lid closing with a solid clunk
a switch flip or camera shutter click
texture: a quiet computer room tone hum
the steady low hum of a computer in a quiet room
rain heard from inside a room, drops on the window glass
birds singing in a spring meadow
a morning field recording of birdsong in the countryside
wind blowing through grass and leaves
a breeze rustling tall grass and leaves
fast typing on a mechanical keyboard
